ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Windows Credential Editor (WCE) Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of Windows Credential Editor (WCE)

sequences.query: ((process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=a53a02b997935fd8eedcb5f7abab9b9f.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=e96a73c7bf33a464c510ede582318bf2.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\ \\-S$") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\services\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\clussvc\\\.exe$"))
